# List of awards and nominations received by Ram Gopal Varma

}}
Ram Gopal Varma (born 7 April 1962) is an Indian film director, screenwriter, and producer, primarily known for his work in Hindi and Telugu cinema. Regarded as pioneer of new age Indian cinema, Varma has garnered the National Film Award, the Bimal Roy Memorial National Award, seven state Nandi Awards, two Bollywood Filmfare Awards, and five Bollywood Movie Awards.
